segments.t: As the draft officers escort a stunned Aleksandr away to serve in the army, Lyova happily takes back his sous-chef title and reinstates Max as a line cook. Meanwhile at the hospital, supplier Timur barges loudly into the ward and ruins Viktor Petrovich's latest attempt at playing weak for Elena.
Саша, иди на свое рабочее место.
Виктор Петрович не пришел в себя.
Now let's break down each line of their conversation.

'The question is, how did they track him down?' Asking whether the question is how did they track him down puts Sasha right on the defensive. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
'Devil only knows.' Vika tells Barinov that devil only knows without dressing it up.
'By his last name, probably.' Between the shift and the room, Sasha gives Barinov a quick, grounded response.

'No, you will not do that, right?' When Barinov asks if Sasha will not do that right, Sasha has to answer fast. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
'You will not, all right then.' Vika reminds Barinov that Barinov will not all right then before the moment passes.
'You are a line cook again.' Because Barinov is a line cook again, Sasha treats the matter as settled. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
Саша, иди на свое рабочее место.
'Sasha, go back to your workstation.' Going back to Sasha's workstation moves the conversation forward without extra drama.
'Do you think I am constantly lying?' By asking whether Barinov thinks she is constantly lying, Vika presses Barinov for a straight answer.
'Oh, not at all!' With the truth and moment at stake, Sasha reacts without holding back. Notice how she sticks to the formal "you", keeping a professional line between them.
'Hello, my angel, Viktor...' Around the conversation and hospital, Barinov sets a calm, everyday tone with Sasha.
'Quiet, quiet, Timur.' With the conversation and plan in play, Vika keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
Виктор Петрович не пришел в себя.
'Viktor Petrovich has not regained consciousness yet.' Realizing that Viktor Petrovich has not regained consciousness yet changes how Sasha handles the situation.

'Could you please not shout in here?' Asking whether Sasha pleases not shout in here cuts straight through the tension between Barinov and Sasha. There is no "you" needed in the Russian here: one short word states the rule for everyone in the room. Now let's put it all back together and hear the whole scene again.
Саша, иди на свое рабочее место.
Виктор Петрович не пришел в себя.

That wraps up this scene as with Aleksandr hauled off to the army, Lyova reinstates Max as a regular cook while Timur bursts into the hospital ward and ruins Barinov's second attempt at playing unconscious. Until next time!
